verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Hoppscotch serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200) at docs.hoppscotch.io that indexes its documentation. Several cited docs pages are served as raw .md URLs, which gives agents markdown-friendly docs to ingest. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or explicit first-party guidance on agent-oriented docs, no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming them.
